subject: infra.energy
name: Data-centre water policy
what_would_settle_it: the only country-specific energy source the base holds; probed 2026-08-05, no instrument on data-centre water use exists; the cloud directives cover cooling and humidity but not water

subject: infra.capacity
name: Sovereign AI compute
what_would_settle_it: named-analyst opinion whose author sells sovereign AI infrastructure; probed 2026-08-05, no government document establishes national AI compute capacity; the nearest instrument is a continental pre-qualification exercise, not a Rwandan programme

subject: data.satellite
name: Space programme appropriation
what_would_settle_it: the only satellite-data source the base holds for this country; probed 2026-08-05, the 2023/24 development budget annex carries the space agency by project and funding type

subject: gov.policy
name: National AI risk-assessment and harms-monitoring body
what_would_settle_it: qualitative workshops, not a survey, and the report claims no representativeness; probed 2026-08-05, no such body is constituted; the 2023 AI policy only recommends a responsible AI office, which an external observatory recorded as not yet operational in February 2026, and the June 2026 AI agency's establishing law was not found

subject: gov.policy
name: Review framework for commercial AI partnerships
what_would_settle_it: external commentary, attributed not adopted; probed 2026-08-05, no instrument requiring review or disclosure of commercial AI partnerships exists; the only material found is external commentary asserting the same

subject: geopol.eu
name: European adequacy decision
what_would_settle_it: desk-review analysis, with the counts round estimates single-sourced to a secondary tracker; probed 2026-08-05, the Commission's own list of recognised third countries names no African state, establishing the negative as at 2026

subject: tech.ai
section: Artificial intelligence and the technology sector
name: Sovereign AI compute or national model
what_would_settle_it: a named analyst's dependency argument plus the absence of any contrary record; probed 2026-08-05, a June 2026 cabinet decision creating an AI agency is reported but no establishing law, gazette entry or compute procurement was found, and the only national-model candidate is a private company announcement

subject: geopol.china
section: Artificial intelligence and the technology sector
name: Bilateral technology instrument with China
